newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Barlo says improvement to continue in H2.
newsitem.headline: Barlo says improvement to continue in H2.

text.p: Irish radiator and plastics manufacturer Barlo Group Plc said on Monday that the improvement in business seen in the first half is likely to continue into the second half of its financial year.

"A number of trends which affected the group adversely in recent years, notably currency movements, raw material prices and economic conditions, are currently moving in a favourable direction," Chief Executive, Tony Mullins, said in a results statement.
"These, together with the restructuring programme, are directly benefiting the performance of the group," he added.
Earlier, Barlo announced pre-tax profits of 2.16 million Irish pounds for the six months to September 30, 1996.
The group said operating profits for the period had risen to 3.03 million Irish pounds from 2.19 million punts in the corresponding period last year.
Barlo said borrowing had reduced significantly from last year's level at 25.4 million Irish pounds to 19.4 million punts leaving gearing at 44 percent compared to 53 percent last year.
"The results mainly reflect a general improvement in business with particular growth in the radiator business in the UK and a strong recovery at Stanley Smith Plastics," Mullins said.
